# VSL - Vietnamese Sign Language (Cropped) ## 1. Overview & Scale **VSL - Vietnamese Sign Language (Cropped)** is a large-scale Vietnamese Sign Language (VSL) dataset for Sign Language Recognition (SLR). * **Vocabulary**: 472 glosses (Vietnamese words). * **Size**: 82.37 GB (includes ~10 GB of processed/augmented data and ~72 GB of raw videos). * **Data Sources**: Sourced from the **VSL400 dataset** (signer-recorded) and **online-sourced videos** (internet-harvested). * **Modalities**: * **Processed (224x224, ~10 GB)**: Cropped front-view videos (`.mp4`) and 3D skeleton keypoints (`.npy`, shape `[T, 76, 3]` from MediaPipe Holistic). Available in **Canonical** (26,446 raw clips) and **Augmented** (30,054 clips, 0% missing joints) versions. * **Raw Videos (~72 GB)**: Original uncropped multi-view video files (containing `front_view`, `left_view`, and `right_view` camera angles in VSL400) and online sources. --- ## 2. Core Preprocessing Techniques * **Front-View Filtering & Gloss Merging**: * Only the **front-view** camera perspective was extracted from the raw multi-view directories (`front_view` folders). * Videos from both VSL400 and online sources were then **merged and grouped by gloss name** to create the unified input corpus before running the cropping and keypoint extraction processes. * **Hybrid Stratified Splitting**: * **By Gloss**: Splitting is stratified per gloss (80% train / 20% test) to ensure all 472 vocabulary classes are represented. * **By Signer**: Core VSL400 dataset splits Train/Test by Signer ID (Unseen Signers in Test) to prevent data leakage. * **Joint Imputation**: Missing keypoints (MediaPipe detection failures) are fully repaired using linear interpolation and edge padding, achieving 0.0% missing joints in the Augmented set. * **Modality-Specific Augmentations**: * **RGB videos**: Photometric noise (blur, contrast, brightness, crop). * **Skeleton keypoints**: Geometric 3D rotations (camera angles) and temporal speed perturbations. * *Note: Horizontal flips are disabled to preserve hand orientation meanings.* --- ## 3. Data Storage The dataset is structured on Kaggle as follows: 
vsl-vietnamese-sign-language-cropped/
|-- processed/
|   |-- processed/
|       |-- frame_splited/
|       |   |-- train/{gloss}/{videoid}.mp4
|       |   |-- test/{gloss}/{videoid}.mp4
|       |-- keypoints_splited/
|           |-- train/{gloss}/{videoid}.npy
|           |-- test/{gloss}/{videoid}.npy
|
|-- processed_augmented/
|   |-- processed_augmented/
|       |-- frame_splited/
|       |   |-- train/{gloss}/{videoid}.mp4
|       |   |-- test/{gloss}/{videoid}.mp4
|       |-- keypoints_splited/
|       |   |-- train/{gloss}/{videoid}.npy
|       |   |-- test/{gloss}/{videoid}.npy
|       `-- vsl_full_front_augmented.json
|
`-- raw/
    |-- raw/
        |-- VSL400/
        |   |-- Part_1/
        |   |-- Part_2/
        |   |-- Part_3/
        |   |-- Part_4/
        |   |-- Part_5/
        |   |-- Part_6/
        |   |-- Part_7/
        |-- online_sourced/
        |   |-- train/
        |   |-- test/
        |   |-- label_mapping.pk
